import sys

def is_idempotent(f):
    n = len(f)
    for x in range(1, n + 1):
        if f[f[x - 1] - 1] != f[x - 1]:
            return False
    return True

def find_min_k(n, f):
    k = 1
    current_f = f[:]
    while not is_idempotent(current_f):
        k += 1
        next_f = [current_f[x - 1] for x in current_f]
        current_f = next_f
    return k

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    f = list(map(int, data[1:]))
    
    k = find_min_k(n, f)
    print(k)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
